title: Answer: theoretical virtue, correlates, and photon pulses

statements.text: Nagasawa and Wager compare cosmopsychism with panpsychism by its theoretical advantages. Goff leaves the conditions under which local subjects exist to the best empirical theory of the physical correlates of consciousness. Shani and Keppler propose testing their mechanism through its predicted photon pulses and its fit with neural correlates.
